citation: Schalk G, McFarland DJ, Hinterberger T, Birbaumer N, Wolpaw JR. BCI2000: a general-purpose brain-computer interface (BCI) system. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2004;51(6):1034-1043. EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database, PhysioNet (Goldberger et al. 2000).
record_used: subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed rest), occipital channels O1 and Oz, first 10 s (1600 samples) at 160 Hz, extracted from the git-tracked EDF (S002R02.edf) via readEDF (the same 64-channel record the sibling Hjorth case uses).
pipeline: readRDS(o1_s002r02) + readRDS(oz_s002r02) -> PhysioCrossModal::phaseLockingValue(freq_band=c(8,13), method='hilbert'): band-pass (Butterworth order 4) both channels to the alpha band, take the Hilbert instantaneous phase, and compute PLV = |mean(exp(i*(phi_O1 - phi_Oz)))|. The reference re-computes the PLV with an independent scipy pipeline (scipy.signal.butter+filtfilt+hilbert), verifies ground-truth recovery on constructed phase-locked/independent signals, and checks the summation formula (via reticulate). Deterministic (the recovery check is seeded).
note: The tracked inputs are eval/data/plv-eeg/{o1,oz}_s002r02.rds. The phase-locking value measures phase-only synchronization (amplitude-insensitive) between two signals in a band. phaseLockingValue is validated three ways: it recovers ground truth (constructed phase-locked signals -> PLV 0.995, independent -> PLV 0.009); it reproduces an independent scipy Hilbert-band PLV to max |diff| ~ 8e-5 (an AGREEMENT: R's and scipy's filtfilt use different edge padding so the filtered signals differ, but PLV is phase-robust, so for the strongly-locked O1-Oz alpha the agreement is tight); and the PLV summation formula is exact. The finding: a high posterior alpha PLV (0.92, mean phase lag ~0.08 rad -- nearly in phase) -- the eyes-closed occipital alpha rhythm is phase-synchronized across neighbouring occipital sites. NOTE: PLV is amplitude-blind but NOT volume-conduction-robust; nearby-channel PLV can be inflated by shared sources (use PLI/wPLI to discount zero-lag coupling).
